Messages.Body:
This is a link to enter card ideas into a card idea database. Currently, anyone with this link can add a card.

Library Card Form

Currently, anyone can view and download the spreadsheet:

Library Card Spreadsheet

Currently, I am the only person who can edit the spreadsheet, but I can add people with permissions to edit the spreadsheet and the form.

It probably makes more sense for one person or a small group of people to have the ability to add to the database, but consider this an open Beta.

I will begin populating the database with ideas from this forum. If people will use this database, please sticky this thread. Please comment in this thread if you have ideas concerning this database.

Messages.Author: direwolf
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> An additional field containing any url to a related topic could be useful (eg. to redirect to this forum to see existing comments).
>
> Another disctinct text field containing the flavor text would also be appreciated.
>
I fear that adding too many questions/fields will seem like a hassle and deter people from using the form to add their card ideas.

The "url" field idea would be a little redundant with the "purpose" field. So what would be more useful: a brief explanation of the card idea, or a url leading presumably to the discussion of the card idea?

I think the brief explanation is more likely to be used by the person filling out the form, but the URL would be more useful to someone willing to put in the time to do more research about the card idea.

As for adding a flavor text... I don't think it's a good idea because as I said above, I think it's asking the user for more work than is necessary. Also, I think the focus should be on the mechanics.

However, this is supposed to be fun, and someone who puts the time and work into an appropriate flavor text will appreciate it. Also, a well chosen flavor text can inform as to the card concept.

So, I will add a flavor text field, but I want to hear more discussion about the "card purpose" vs. "url" fields. Perhaps I should have them both?
